qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability / Opaque trading book, REJECT). Centrica's earnings are heavily driven by Centrica Energy (formerly Energy Marketing & Trading), a large proprietary energy trading and optimization book that swings wildly and cannot be verified from the outside. Combined with retail supply subject to Ofgem price caps and nuclear/storage assets, the economic engine lacks transparent, predictable compounding.
qualitative.evidence: Centrica Energy operating profits fluctuated from £1.4B in 2022 to £774M in 2023 and £307M in 2024 due to market volatility. British Gas retail margins remain constrained by the UK default tariff price cap, and upstream asset dependencies make earnings unpredictable.
